name: Shanghai Jiaoda Onlly Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Jiaoda Onlly Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, and production of raw materials and fininshed products of food and health food in China and internationally. It is also involved in the operation and management of elderly medical care institutions, including hospitals and nursing homes; and the provision of management consulting services to non-profit hospitals, nursing homes and retirement homes. In addition, it provides functional health care products; probiotics; plant extracts; personal care products; and pet supplies.
